messages:
chris: Kickoff — I'm starting a helm upgrade for payments-service to chart v1.4.2 in prod. Plan: staggered canary across zones (10% per zone), pin chart + container image, keep rolling window 23:00-02:00 UTC. @alice could you confirm values override for the new health probe?

alice: noted. the new chart changes the readiness path to /healthz/readiness and lowers timeout defaults. we'll need to set readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds=5 and failureThreshold=6 for prod. also want to avoid changing replicas during canary.

bob: +1 to pinning. suggest 10% per zone for 15m each, check 5m stable after each zone before proceeding. keep CPU autoscaler paused for canary.

carol: question — the liveness probe path also changed, right? last deploy had 503 flaps after switching path. can we set initialDelaySeconds=30 to be safe?

alice: yes liveness path -> /healthz/liveness. I'll set initialDelaySeconds=30 and keep failureThreshold conservative. here's the values patch I propose:

```yaml
readinessProbe:
  path: /healthz/readiness
  timeoutSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 6
livenessProbe:
  path: /healthz/liveness
  initialDelaySeconds: 30
  timeoutSeconds: 2
replicaCount: 6
autoscaling:
  enabled: false  # pause during canary
```

chris: thanks. we should also pin chart and image to avoid surprises: chartVersion=1.4.2, image.tag=2026-03-19-prod. we'll run helm upgrade --install with --atomic and a preflight dry-run. plan to use canary scheduling (zone-by-zone).

bob: operational commands I expect to run:

```bash
helm upgrade --install payments-service redwood/payments --version 1.4.2 \
  --namespace prod --set image.tag=2026-03-19-prod \
  --set autoscaling.enabled=false --timeout 10m --atomic --wait
# canary helper (example)
kubectl label deployment payments-service canary=zone-a --overwrite
# pause hpa
kubectl scale deployment payments-service --replicas=6 --namespace prod
```

dave: +1. fallback plan: if any zone shows >1.5x error rate or latency > 2s p95 after the 5m verification window, we'll rollback to chart v1.4.1 and trigger incident channel. also prepare hotfix branch with previous probes.

carol: one more ask — add a short smoke test to the deploy pipeline that curls /healthz/readiness and verifies 200 for 5 consecutive attempts before marking canary healthy.

chris: agreed. I'll add the smoke test to the pipeline and schedule the rollout. tagging @deploy-bot to run preflight now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Preflight started for payments-service -> chart 1.4.2 (image 2026-03-19-prod). Checks: values schema ok, CRD compatibility ok, kube version compat ok. Detected liveness/readiness probe changes — verifying probe URIs. Dry-run helm install completed. No immediate failures.

deploy-bot: Scheduling staged canary: zone-a (10%) @ 2026-03-19T23:05Z, zone-b (10%) @ 2026-03-19T23:25Z, zone-c (10%) @ 2026-03-19T23:45Z. Will wait 15m per zone with 5m verification.

alice: I'll watch the first zone and be ready to revert probe changes if we see flakiness.

chris: final decision — proceed with pinned chart/image and staggered canary. if any step fails use rollback plan (chart 1.4.1). I'll post rollout notes to the releases doc after completion. :thumbsup:
